description:
Portrait Changer

English Update - v1.0.7a

For Starsector 0.98a-RC8

Change portraits, names, and genders without leaving the game.

Source code

|

Changelog and older versions

Original English mod:

CY, Lukas04

Chinese 1.0.7 update:

Skillless Noob (literal translation of the Chinese username)

1.0.7a English update:

Mirarara

Required mods:

LunaLib

Adding to an ongoing game:

Safe

Updating:

Clean installation recommended when replacing an older version

Removing from an ongoing game:

Safe

What is this?

Portrait Changer adds an Intel screen that allows you to change the portraits, names, and genders of characters in your campaign.

This release is an updated English version of

Portrait Changer 1.0.1

by

CY and Lukas04

.

The original English mod was expanded to version 1.0.7 by the Chinese community. This release brings those newer features back into English and adds some additional functionality.

The Chinese 1.0.7 update was made by

Skillless Noob

. See the

original Chinese thread

for the original release and complete details.

Change your player portrait at any time during a campaign.Change officer and administrator portraits directly from the Intel screen.Change character names, including randomly selecting names from the game or a custom name pool.Change character genders independently of their portrait.Change local NPCs registered at the planet or station you are currently visiting.Support for additional character groups, including AI administrators, Nexerelin agents, and selected important NPCs.Random Portrait and Random Name options for quickly changing characters.LunaLib settings allow different character groups and portrait options to be enabled or disabled.

Preview

Open the Intel screen and select Change Portrait under Personal. Select the character you want to edit, then change their portrait, name, or gender.

Installation

See

Adding mods to your game: first steps

Install LunaLib.Download and extract Portrait Changer.Place the PortraitChanger folder inside your Starsector mods folder.Enable Portrait Changer in the Starsector launcher.

Updating:

A clean installation is recommended when replacing an older Portrait Changer version. Delete the previous PortraitChanger folder before copying the new version.

Known compatibility issues:

Changing story-critical or otherwise important NPCs may interfere with scripts from Starsector or other mods. The Important People option is disabled by default and should only be enabled if you understand the possible consequences.

How to use

Open the Intel screen.Select Change Portrait under Personal.Select the character you want to modify at the top of the screen.Select a portrait, or use Random Portrait.Use Apply Gender to change the selected character's gender.Enter a new name and use Apply Name, or select Random Name.

To include NPCs at the planet or station you are currently visiting, enable the relevant option in LunaLib settings and open Portrait Changer while visiting that market.

Available character groups and portrait pools can also be configured through LunaLib.

[close]

FAQ

Can this be added to an existing campaign?

Yes. The mod can be added during an ongoing campaign.

Can this be removed from an existing campaign?

Yes. The mod is designed to be safely removable from an ongoing campaign.

Where is Portrait Changer?

Open Intel and look under the Personal section for Change Portrait.

Can I change NPCs at a planet or station?

Yes. Version 1.0.7a can show NPCs registered at the market you are currently visiting. Enable Current Planet/Station NPCs in the LunaLib settings first.

Can I change important story characters?

The option exists, but it is disabled by default. Changing story-critical NPCs may interfere with scripts from the base game or other mods, so use it with caution.

Can I add my own random names?

Yes. Add one name per line to optional_name_pool.txt in the mod folder. If the file is empty, Random Name uses names generated by the game.

Does it support Nexerelin agents?

Yes. If Nexerelin is installed, support for player-faction agents can be enabled in LunaLib settings.[close]

About this English releaseThe original English version of Portrait Changer was created by

CY and Lukas04

.

A later Chinese version expanded the mod with additional character types, LunaLib configuration, random portraits, name changing, and other improvements. Version 1.0.7 of that update was released by

Skillless Noob

.

This English release uses the original English version together with the newer Chinese 1.0.7 version as its base.

AI-assisted tools were used to migrate the English translation to the newer codebase and to assist with implementing additional features.

Afterwards, I manually reviewed the result and fixed bugs and other issues in the translated and modified version.

My additional changes include:

English support for the newer 1.0.7 functionality.Support for every NPC registered at the market currently being visited.The ability to change the gender of characters whose portraits can be changed.Bug fixes and corrections made after testing the updated version.
